name: How does FSBO marketing help differ from hiring a full-service real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: How does FSBO marketing help differ from hiring a full-service real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: FSBO marketing help provides tools and strategies for you to market your home, while you remain responsible for direct buyer interaction, negotiations, and contract management. A full-service real estate agent handles all aspects of the sale, including marketing, showing coordination, negotiation, and guiding you through closing processes. The practical tradeoff is that FSBO marketing typically involves upfront costs and significant personal involvement, whereas an agent charges a commission at closing but manages the entire transaction for you.
acceptedAnswer.description: FSBO marketing help assists with promotion while you manage sales; a full-service agent handles everything for a commission at closing, offering different levels of involvement and cost structures.
